content_html:
6 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday evening.

The stories

  • Fielding Street, roadworks in Middleton from 3 November 2026 Middleton
    Rochdale Borough Council lists work affecting Fielding Street in Middleton; expected timings: 9am–4pm on Tuesday, 3 November 2026 9am–4pm on Wednesday, 4 November 2026 9am–4pm…
  • Secondary school applications close on 31 October: what Rochdale parents need to know Rochdale
    The council advises families to list five preferences and apply by Saturday 31 October. Late applications are considered after National Offer Day on 1 March 2027.
  • Rochdale’s £5m crisis support fund: what help is available this winter and how to ask Rochdale
    The council lists help with sudden financial emergencies, housing costs and essential goods. Different schemes have different rules; an award is not automatic.
  • Crawley Town vs. Rochdale: Live Updates from League Two Match Rochdale
    Crawley Town faced Rochdale in a League Two match on October 19, with live updates and stats available during the game.
  • Regina Teen Charged After BB Handgun Seized on Rochdale Boulevard Rochdale
    A 15-year-old girl faces multiple charges after Regina police seized a BB handgun during an investigation on Rochdale Boulevard on October 17.
  • Rochdale Sleep Out Raises Funds for Homeless Support Rochdale
    Fundraisers gathered at Crown Oil Arena for the annual Sleep Out, raising awareness and funds for homelessness initiatives in the community.

Weather: Light rain 12°C in Rochdale today.

The Morning Briefing is published every day at 9am. Got a story? Tell the newsdesk.
